title: Ordinary additive strict tower limit functor
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with limits indexed by $\mathbf N^{op}$, and let $\operatorname{Tow}(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},A)$ be its category of strict inverse sequences [def-weil-inverse-system]. Define $\operatorname{towerLimit}_A:\operatorname{Tow}(A)\to A$ to be the ordinary chosen limit functor: its object at a tower $X$ is $\lim_n X_n$, and its morphism at a tower map is the unique map commuting with every limit projection. Its additive-functor instance [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor] is the standard instance obtained from preservation of binary products. This is the ordinary limit of strict diagrams in $A$, before passing to complexes or derived categories.
